purpose: Remove repeated PR tool compilation and restore local incremental compilation without changing gate selection, detector versions, or authoritative runner semantics.

scope.registered_surface: .github/workflows/quality.yml, .cargo/config.toml, tools/xtask policy validation, and developer workflow documentation

ci_tool_provisioning: restore cargo-nextest 0.9.138, cargo-deny 0.19.9, cargo-audit 0.22.2, and cargo-machete 0.9.2 from an operating-system, architecture, Rust-version, and exact-tool-version key
compile the same locked tool versions only on an exact cache miss
verify every restored or freshly compiled tool reports its pinned version before the authoritative PR runner executes
publish a verified cold cache only from a trusted push to the protected main branch; pull-request workflows cannot persist executable tool caches
cache no repository target directory or gate evidence
local_development: remove the repository-wide Cargo configuration override that disabled incremental compilation
retain the explicit incremental development and test profiles
retain CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 in trusted CI for reproducible evidence
document one focused-test, pre-commit, pre-push, and protected-CI validation ladder without duplicate adjacent PR-profile runs
unchanged: cargo xtask quality remains the authoritative quality interface
all 13 routine PR gates, their tools, versions, timeouts, retries, and evidence semantics
scheduled extended and release qualification gate selection
application scope, dependencies, unsafe-code policy, and Release 1 qualification status

detection_gained: the policy gate rejects removal or revision drift of the pinned actions/cache restore and trusted-main save actions, exact cache key, cache-miss install condition, custom tool root, or restored-tool verification
the policy gate rejects a repository-wide local incremental-compilation disable
black-box fixtures prove both workflow safeguards and the local compilation contract fail closed
detection_lost: none; the same locked detectors execute through the same authoritative runner and cached binaries must report every exact registered version

migration.ci: A cache miss compiles the four pinned tools. Only a trusted protected-main push may store the verified result. Later pull requests may restore that default-branch cache and fail closed if any required binary or expected version is absent.
migration.local: Existing development and test profile settings take effect after the global override is removed. No command or hook changes are required.
migration.invalidation: Any runner operating system, architecture, Rust version, or pinned tool version change creates a distinct cache key and cold installation. The first pull request using a new key remains cold; the protected-main run after merge establishes the trusted cache.

trusted_ci.interpretation: source compilation of the four pinned Cargo tools dominated the successful PR run

local.result: passed-local-diagnostic in 17.82 seconds; 63 of 63 tests passed
local.retained_negative_observation: nextest emitted one existing LEAK marker for quality_evidence_uses_a_stable_redacted_environment_digest even though the canonical runner returned passed; this change does not hide, erase, or claim to resolve it

after.focused_contracts: 20 xtask unit tests and 46 black-box policy fixtures passed

canonical_pr_profile.result: passed-local-diagnostic in 24.53 seconds; 66 of 66 tests passed
canonical_pr_profile.reason: the source tree was dirty and the run was not trusted CI

after.warm_ci: pending trusted cold and warm CI runs; this local change makes no unmeasured CI duration claim

evidence.mutation: not run in this change: PC-0003 assigns mutation and coverage to scheduled extended evidence, and this policy-only change makes no mutation claim

dual_run: The unchanged local PR profile is measured before and after the provisioning/configuration change. Trusted CI must retain the cold cache-miss attempt and a later warm cache-hit attempt before the workflow optimization is considered operationally verified.
approval_status: pending independent review; no approval is claimed by this local evidence
qualification_status: Implemented candidate only; no Release 1 target is Qualified by this change.
